regime: Oil rebound on Iran strike with metals giving back gains, ahead of the midterms
takeaway: Oil bounced about 1% after a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, which revived inflation worries and Fed hike bets and pulled gold down about 1% and silver more than 3%. Yields and the yen-dollar rate edged higher, while stock futures were mixed as Apple slipped on a weaker margin outlook. Today's midterm results and Friday's jobs report could keep moves large.
